planHintInvoices: Invoices, partial, prepayment, pro forma and self-billing invoices with PDF, numbering and email. Counts issued invoices.
planHintQuotes: Quotes with revisions and PDF; you record when a client accepts. Counts quotes sent.
planHintSwissQR: QR-bill on every invoice: QR-IBAN in CHF, or a Swiss or Liechtenstein IBAN in CHF or EUR.
planHintRevolut: A revolut.me link and QR code; the payer enters the amount and reference shown. No automatic payment confirmation.
planHintPayments: Record full and partial payments; open, overdue and paid at a glance. No bank import.
planHintCurrencies: Invoice in any currency with cents; CHF totals round to 5 Rappen.
planHintVAT: Prices with or without VAT, several rates on one invoice, and exempt lines.
planHintReminders: Reminder levels with fees, sent on time for every overdue invoice.
planHintInstalments: Split an invoice into instalments that are issued and reminded on their own.
planRowCorrections: Credit notes, debit notes and corrections
planHintCorrections: Correct or cancel an issued invoice the way auditors expect.
planHintEInvoice: XRechnung (UBL and CII), Peppol BIS Billing 3.0, Factur-X / ZUGFeRD, CIUS-RO and KSeF FA(3) files to download and upload yourself; no network delivery.
planHintScheduling: One-off and recurring sessions with clients, days off and email reminders. Counts sessions scheduled a month.
planHintBookingLinks: A link where new clients book a free slot themselves; existing clients book in the client portal (Business).
planHintCalendarSync: Two-way sync with Google Calendar and Outlook, plus a private iCal feed.
planHintExpenses: Expenses with receipts, categories and booking. Counts expenses added a month.
planHintDocuments: Folders that file themselves by client and year, tags, grouped views and ZIP downloads.
planHintDashboard: Revenue, open invoices and what is due, at a glance.
planHintClients: Companies and people with contacts, addresses and payment terms.
planHintUID: Find a Swiss company by name and fill in its address and UID; verified UIDs are marked.
planHintEngagements: Ongoing work billed weekly, monthly, quarterly or yearly, with its entries. Counts open engagements.
planHintEmails: Invoices, quotes, reminders and documents emailed from your company name, with replies to you. Counts recipients a month.
planHintSignatures: Simple electronic signatures with up to 10 signers; signers need no account. Counts signature requests a month.
planHintContracts: Turn a quote into a numbered contract: written by AI, based on an example, or from your template, and send it for signature.
planRowPortal: White-labelled client portal on your own domain
planHintPortal: Clients sign in to see and pay invoices, download quotes and documents and book sessions, under your name and domain.
planHintHeidi: Ask about your business, draft emails and texts. Counts AI tokens a month.
planHintAIImport: Drop PDFs, photos or spreadsheets — invoices, clients and expenses are created for you.
planHintAIFiling: Uploads are tagged and moved into the right client or expense folder.
planHintAutomations: Automatic reminders, instalments, retainer invoice drafts and VAT period reminders. Counts automatic actions a month.
planHintAPI: Personal API tokens for the REST API and the MCP server, so your own tools and AI agents can work with your data.
planHintPeople: Team members, the owner included. Clients and signers never count.
planHintSignIn: Sign in without passwords: passkeys, Google or an email code, with optional two-factor authentication.
planHintAudit: Close months so nothing changes behind you; every financial event is kept in a tamper-evident log.
planHintVATReturns: eCH-0217 XML for the ESTV ePortal, with PDF and CSV.
planHintLedger: A ledger from your invoices and expenses, exported for Banana, bexio, Abacus or as CSV.
planHintDataExport: The whole workspace as a ZIP, and CSV files of clients, products, invoices, expenses and engagements.
planHintApprovals: Approvals before invoices are issued, quotes sent or expenses booked.
planHintEmployees: Staff records, private HR files and a payroll register. No payroll calculation or filings.
planHintBranding: On Free and Basic, client emails and PDFs carry a small “Sent with Helvetly” line.
planHintLanguages: The app, the client portal, PDFs and client emails in each of them.
planHintSupport: Answered on Swiss business days, on every plan.
planHintRoles: Owner, admin, member, accountant and read-only roles, with access set per area.
